content: Baolo Niman Kunlade Chonjizho
Ingiese Mexiha Ersai yenyinghala ta niman kunlade oluzhi bafanzi sousan bi Baolo tande oluzhi onxian giezho.
Huda tande oluzhi nenjienghalane made nie tebieji renwu ogisei ta kenjin chenliezhi daozho.
Huda mimii made qinsi mejieghawo. Enei bi eqighandei jiendanghan huaizhi daozho.
Ta onshise bi Mexihani mimii dunjiresanyi mejiene.
Ene mimii isii Huda ede Shenlinyi tungo giezhi zhiguitu shitu, xienzhiladene mejieghasan mutun eqighanku xienzidedu kunde ese mejieghazho.
Ene mimishi niman kunla gouxioxii tungo giezhi Mexiha Ersai miende hhantu caichanyi jienliechen danlazhi nie beyeni iyanzi gholuzhi hhantu Huda dain giesanyi jienliene.
Hudai nenjienghala bi gouxioxide hoji danlazho. Huda nenlighalane made ene nenlini ogizho.
Shentulai dundadu zui ganise da gajitu made Huda nenjien ogizhi Mexihani mejiezhi baragha daku olonnii niman kunlade chonji giezho.
Pse soyujilai zhayaghasan Hudai sudoro eqighanse izhi niuighasan mimitu jihuai olon kunlade man minbai olugha giezho.
Ingiekushi ede jiohuii tungo giezhi asiman jiere gonjisan, qienli bareisanlade Hudai yanyanji aghelilai mejieghane giezho.
Eneshi mai Ezhan Mexiha Ersai tungo giezhi gholusan Hudai chanqiku jihua wo.
Matan Mexiha Ersai sudoro hhei xianxin giezhi danzine fugiedaghazhi ulie inxin giedene Hudai melie echine.
Ingiese bi tai xiahua gieye, bi tande oluzhi shouku giewo giezhi yuchou bu gie. Eneshi tai kuaikui wo.
Baoloni Onxian
Ingiese bi Adai melie xiutuliezhi onxian giezho.
Hheshi asiman, zemin jieredu soyuji jiawulade man niere ogisan wo.
Hhe zhao goya olon fama, Shenlinne tungo giezhi tai sudorodu xianxin gieku zhugheni lilianghala khiduzhegha gie.
Xianxin giekughala Mexiha tai zhughede souzhi tai oreku dunda genzi bareighazhi undanlagha gie.
Ingie tande nenli bizhi soyuji shentulare Mexihani oreku matu aghui, fudu, undu, gun bikui goude mejieghadene
hhei oreku kunni sumulakuse daosanyi tande mejieghazhi Hudai hulunshighakughala tai hulunshigha gie.
Nenlini matanyi dunda ochirazhi matan xiahua giezhi sumulasanse pse olon chenjighasan Hudade
jiohui, Mexiha Ersai tungo giezhi zuzubeibei chanqi izhi kuaikui ogi. Amine!
